text:
marta: Heads-up — we need increased GPU quotas + capacity reservations in two subscriptions for next week's Dedicated test run. Target regions: westeurope and eastus2. SKUs: Standard_ND40rs_v2 (NDv2) + Standard_NC24rs_v3 (NCv3). Current quotas are 0 for ND40rs_v2 in both subs. Can someone start the quota/support requests and track them here?

kevin: On it. I just opened an Azure support case for the westeurope subscription. SR: SR-2026-00091234. Request details: add 8 ND40rs_v2 and 16 NC24rs_v3, tenancy type = capacity reservation, start 2026-04-01 00:00 UTC, duration 30 days (trial). Added justification: staging performance run for Redwood Dedicated validation.

az-support-bot: Support case SR-2026-00091234 created and assigned to Microsoft GPU team. Expected response SLA: 72h. Case link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/CaseMenuBlade/caseId/SR-2026-00091234

marta: Thanks. For eastus2 we need to request capacity in the customer-facing subscription (prod-test-02). Kevin, can you reuse the same justification but mark it as internal validation? Also we ran into a subnet IP limit when spinning VMSS — we might need increased IPs per NIC / subnet too.

kevin: Opened a second support case for eastus2 on prod-test-02. SR: SR-2026-00091235. Included subnet /ipLimit note: current subnet alloc = 256 IPs, need to bump to 1024 or create additional subnets. Added a screenshot of the NIC error from VMSS: 

```
Deployment failed with error: AllocationFailed - Insufficient IP addresses available in subnet /subscriptions/xxxx/resourceGroups/rg-prod-test/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/vnet-main/subnets/snet-gpu.
```

jia: Pinged our Azure TAM and asked for fast-track escalation; cc'd account team (sales) and Microsoft GPU capacity queue. Also asked TAM to confirm if there are reservation pools in westeurope for ND40rs_v2 in April — they sometimes have regional shortages.

tom: Quick cost check — if we end up with 8 ND40rs_v2 reserved for 30 days, what's the expected blunt monthly cost? We should include an estimate in the support justification so finance can approve.

kevin: Rough calc: ND40rs_v2 reserved instance / capacity reservation pricing is region-dependent; I put a placeholder in the ticket: ~ $22k/month for 8 GPUs (wild estimate), noted pending accurate quote from MS account team. Also added note: we will prefer soft-reservation (capacity but cancelable) to avoid long-term commit until rollout.

marta: Ops note: once quota is approved, we need to coordinate capacity creation with eng-runtime so they can test kernel selection at scale. Ops-oncall, can you block a 2-hour window on 2026-04-02 for the deploy?

ops-oncall: Yep — tentatively blocked 2026-04-02 08:00-10:00 UTC in oncall calendar. I'll update after support confirmations.

kevin: Microsoft replied to SR-2026-00091234: they requested subscription ID + tenant ID + intended VM count per region + VMSS template. I uploaded the VMSS ARM snippet to the SR and included the following template snippet for the NC/ND SKUs.

```json
{
  "sku": {
    "name": "Standard_ND40rs_v2",
    "tier": "Standard",
    "capacity": 8
  },
  "location": "westeurope"
}
```

marta: Added subscription IDs in the SR and flagged the subnet/ip request as separate ticket if MS won't handle vnet quotas in the same flow. Also left a note to ask about cross-subscription capacity mapping — we don't want reservations tied to the wrong tenant.

jia: MS TAM says cross-subscription reservations require the same billing tenant; they asked whether we can consolidate these test subs under the primary billing account. That's a blocker if we need immediate capacity in eastus2.

kevin: I created a follow-up escalation: INC-2026-0456 (internal tracking) to coordinate billing consolidation or an exception. Linking SRs: SR-2026-00091234, SR-2026-00091235 -> INC-2026-0456.

tom: From procurement: if consolidation is needed, procurement needs an approval doc with justification + estimated cost. Kevin, please add the estimate to INC-2026-0456.

kevin: Added estimate and a short justification doc link: https://drive.redwood.com/infra/azure/gpu-quota/estimates-apr2026.pdf

marta: If MS can't provide ND40rs_v2 in eastus2, fallback plan: request ND96asr_v4 (if available) or increase NCv3 count and trade off precision testing for throughput. Please note fallback in the SRs.

az-support-bot: SR-2026-00091235 updated: subnet quota request forwarded to Platform Limits team. Estimated time to resolution 4 business days.

kevin: Will keep this thread updated. Next steps: 1) Wait for MS response (SRs). 2) Confirm billing tenant consolidation or exception (INC). 3) Ops block confirmed. 4) Once quota approved, run small smoke tests (eng-runtime) then scale up.

marta: Thanks — please drop final SR numbers here when closed and include any AR/PR notes for Dedicated onboarding checklist.
